provenance.method: Five fixed-seed ETKDG starts; converged torsion-constrained reference at180degrees (and fixed HOCC for chloroethanol). Rigid scan rotates the rear fragment without relaxation. Relaxed scan uses warm-started constrained local minimization at every integer degree; closure at360 copies0. Neither is a global conformer search, MD trajectory or experimental solution free energy. Fractional angles use linear energy interpolation and a small rigid rotation of the nearest relaxed geometry. Rigid half-grid discrepancy is an observed interpolation diagnostic,not a rigorous error bound.
